_documentation.purpose: Bulk import leads into BazaarPrinting CRM. Generate a JSON file matching this schema exactly.
_documentation.audience: AI assistants or scripts converting data from Instantly, spreadsheets, or other CRMs.
_documentation.output_format: Single JSON object. Root must include a leads array. Keys starting with _ are documentation only — ignored on import.
instructions: Return valid JSON only — no markdown fences, no commentary outside the JSON.
Put one object per person in the leads array (max 500).
Every lead MUST include: first_name, phone, source, industry.
For source and industry: copy the value slug from _lookups (e.g. email, cannabis_cbd) — NEVER use the human label (e.g. Email, Cannabis & CBD).
If interests is set: each true product needs quantities[product] > 0; names must match _lookups.products exactly.
Replace the example lead with all real rows.

_lookups.how_to_use: Pick source and industry from value column. Prefer Download on Admin page for your live database list.

leads._note: DELETE this key — example only. One lead shown; add more objects to this array.
